view.title: C2d — Container overlay: credential topology
view.caption: Who holds which credential — and who does not? A subset of C2b (the module-wiring view) — who resolves which credential, and the one absence that matters most.

nodes.label: conversion
detail: Conversion (cluster A) — 10 components incl. the Invoke Models seam. Only MA holds the gateway credential

nodes.label: validation-certification
detail: Validation-certification (cluster B) — 5 components; static gate → device gate → classify → certify. Device-gate worker holds NO gateway credential (ADR 0013)

nodes.label: secrets store
detail: Interim: CI secret store; the vault is named by the M33 controls-baseline read — PENDING. All credentials resolved by injected reference, never literals (M34/CF8)

nodes.label: test-execution process
detail: Test-execution process, spawned per device run. Separate OS process — shape committed NOW, sandbox technology weeks 3–8 (ADR 0013). NO long-lived credentials; single-run device session token; NEVER the gateway credential. Static capability rules gate entry (supplement, not the control)

nodes.label: Perfecto device lab
detail: INCUMBENT vendor — MSA on file, unread (E1); flows run on mock/synthetic data (E2); NOT covered by E3

nodes.label: Orchestrator AI gateway
detail: Internal gateway; model providers hosted INSIDE the bank — prompts never leave (E4). Version-report contract UNVERIFIED (M5 probe held)

edges.label: Perfecto + test-account credentials, by injected reference (M34)
hand over SINGLE-RUN session token only (ADR 0013)
device session (token expires with the run)
